summary: Specifies the algorithms, parameters, key formats, key sizes and signature format for RPKI subscribers who sign certificates, revocation lists and signed objects, and for relying parties who check them. It was replaced by RFC 7935.

eli5.summary: To keep locks compatible, everyone must use the same kind of key and signature. This lists which ones RPKI uses. It was later replaced by RFC 7935.

questions: which signature algorithm does rpki use
